title: Fall Home Security Checklist: 8 Things to Do Before Winter
summary: Before the days get shorter, run through this home security checklist to stay protected all season.
body_markdown:
Swing by every door in the house — the front door, the back door, the side door, even the one that goes to the garage — and double-check that the door locks, seals, and stays shut. Test your keys to make sure they lock and unlock the door in a clean motion. If you’re having problems or doors aren’t locking as smoothly as you’d like, schedule an appointment with a locksmith to come by and check them out for you.


While you’re thinking about it, this is also a good time to check your[Arlo Video Doorbell](https://us.arlo.com/products/arlo-doorbell) ’s functionality. Check the doorbell chime, test out the 2-Way Audio feature, and ensure that it’s working seamlessly along with your front door’s lock.
